positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Application design and development at large scale. Responsibilities ranged from construction of custom low level web-based controls to full-fledged portals with security, management, workflows and reporting.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Built application from ground up using Microsoft .NET framework, including application security, database design, user interfaces as well as business and data components.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Programmed application development projects from concept to completion, directing activities of 7 developers adhering to the Microsoft Solution Framework (MSF) and Windows DNA specifications.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Developed intranet applications for corporate division using ASP technology, Scripting Languages (JavaScript and VBScript). Accessing SQL Server databases through the implementation of Stored Procedures, occasionally converting raw data into XML format, for client display via XSLT technology.

positions.title: Web/Software Developer
positions.description: Developed Web-Site for pharmacy department. In charge of site design and data connectivity. This project contained use of extensive scripting language (JavaScript & VBScript), as well as a database driven application using COM (MTS) and ADO technology with Microsoft Access databases through OLE DB
